title: 第25章 心机贼重的小狐狸
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
然而，门后的景象，却并非路仙瑶想象中的仙家洞府、琼楼玉宇。

    眼前是一条宽阔却破败不堪的玉石长廊，廊柱断裂倾颓，精美的壁画被利器划得面目全非，地上散落着碎裂的玉砖和不知名的金属碎片。

    长廊两侧，原本应该放置着珍宝或典籍的壁龛空空如也，只留下被暴力撬开的痕迹。

    一些房间的门户洞开，里面同样是一片狼藉，桌椅翻倒，架子空空，连镶嵌在墙上的照明宝珠都被抠走了大半，只留下光秃秃的凹槽。

    “主人，这……这里好像被人抢过一样？”墨燃环顾着四周的破败，大眼睛里满是惊愕和失望，“说好的仙藏呢？怎么什么都没有了？”

    路仙瑶的心也沉了下去。

    眼前的景象，确实像是经历了一场疯狂的洗劫。

    数万年来无人寻得的府邸，原来早已被人捷足先登，而且手段极其粗暴贪婪，几乎没留下任何有价值的东西。

    “看来，我们不是第一个发现这里的人。”

    “虽然这里被洗劫一空了，但我觉得这既然是红月上仙的府邸，必然还有一些前人未知的东西存在，主人，不如我们找找看，还有没有其他遗留下来的仙藏？”墨燃说道。

    路仙瑶的想法和他一致，微笑点点头，“好，听你的。”

    她带着墨燃在这府邸里摸索，虽然府邸已被清空，但她并未因此放松警惕。

    像红月上仙这等大能的府邸，即便被洗劫，也未必就安全。

    路仙瑶一手紧握着琅琊剑，一手将夜明珠举高，小心翼翼地向前探索。

    然而，她预想中的禁制陷阱并未出现。

    看来，之前来到过这里的人，不仅洗劫了宝物，似乎连维持府邸运转的核心禁制也一并破坏了。

    能将红月上仙留下的禁制破坏的人，必定是位大能，也不知道红月上仙留下的东西，还剩下多少。

    不过，按剧情发展，若是红月上仙想留给后人的东西已经被拿走，那整个苍山秘境应该会坍塌才是。

    那就是还没有被拿走！

    路仙瑶带着墨燃继续在府邸内探索，整个府邸很大，大到可以让人迷失方向那种。

    同时，她也发现府邸的院子里种着许多她在外头看到的蓝紫色小花。

    在这破败的府邸里，这些小花却盛开得极好。

    路仙瑶却觉得非同寻常。

    “主人，这里竟然也有刚才我们在上面看到的花诶，我想去摘几朵带回去！”墨燃看见这些蓝紫色小花，高兴地跑过去。
content_en:
However, the scene behind the door is not the fairy cave, Qionglou and Yuyu that Lu Xianyao imagined.

    In front of him was a wide but dilapidated jade corridor. The columns were broken and collapsed. The exquisite murals were scratched beyond recognition by sharp tools. Broken jade bricks and unknown metal fragments were scattered on the ground.

    On both sides of the corridor, the niches that were supposed to contain treasures or classics were empty, leaving only traces of being violently pried open.

    The doors of some rooms were open, and the inside was also in a mess. Tables and chairs were overturned, shelves were empty, and most of the lighting orbs embedded in the walls had been gouged out, leaving only bare grooves.

    "Master, this... this place seems to have been robbed?" Mo Ran looked around at the ruins, his big eyes full of surprise and disappointment, "Where is the promised fairy treasure? Why is there nothing?"

    Lu Xianyao's heart also sank.

    The scene in front of me really seemed like it had gone through a crazy looting.

    The mansion that no one has found for tens of thousands of years has turned out to have been invaded by someone early, and the methods were extremely rough and greedy, leaving almost nothing of value behind.

    "It seems that we are not the first to discover this place."

    "Although this place has been looted, I feel that since this is the mansion of the Red Moon Immortal, there must be some things unknown to the predecessors. Master, why don't we look for it and see if there are any other immortal treasures left behind?" Mo Ran said.

    Lu Xianyao had the same idea as him, smiled and nodded, "Okay, I'll listen to you."

    She groped around the mansion with Mo Ran. Although the mansion had been emptied, she did not relax her vigilance.

    Even if a powerful mansion like Red Moon Immortal is ransacked, it may not be safe.

    Lu Xianyao held the Langya Sword tightly in one hand, raised the Night Pearl high in the other, and cautiously explored forward.

    However, the prohibitive trap she expected did not appear.

    It seems that the people who have been here before have not only looted the treasures, but also destroyed the core restrictions that maintain the operation of the mansion.

    The person who can destroy the restrictions left by the Red Moon Immortal must be a powerful person. I don’t know how much of the things left by the Red Moon Immortal are left.

    However, according to the development of the plot, if what the Red Moon Immortal wants to leave to future generations has been taken away, then the entire Cangshan Secret Realm should collapse.

    That means it hasn’t been taken away yet!

    Lu Xianyao took Mo Ran and continued to explore the mansion. The entire mansion was very large, so big that it could make people lose their way.

    At the same time, she also discovered that the courtyard of the mansion was planted with many small blue-purple flowers that she saw outside.

    In this dilapidated mansion, these little flowers are blooming beautifully.

    Lu Xianyao felt it was unusual.

    "Master, there are actually flowers here that we just saw above. I want to pick a few and take them back!" Mo Ran ran over happily when he saw these blue-purple flowers.
